value.name: Marylin reads Miles as sensitive
value.description: Marylin tells Miles he looks like he was a very sensitive child and notes his expressive eyes.
evidence: You look like you were a very sensitive child. You have expressive eyes.

value.name: Miles examines childhood photo
value.description: Miles walks over to look at the picture Marylin is discussing.
evidence: Miles walks over to look at the picture.

value.name: Marylin praises Miles's mother
value.description: Marylin says Miles's mother was very beautiful and suggests she must be proud of him.
evidence: MARYLIN And your mother was very beautiful. She must be proud of you.

value.name: Miles reveals maternal indifference
value.description: Miles admits his mother never particularly cared for him, complicating Marylin's assumption of a loving relationship.
evidence: MILES She never particularly cared for me.

value.name: Marylin questions maternal love
value.description: Marylin asks whether Miles's mother did not love him, pushing him to clarify the emotional wound.

value.name: Miles explains conditional maternal love
value.description: Miles insists his mother loved him as her son but says he was not her type and that she found him difficult as a baby.
evidence: MILES No. She loved me. She would never not love her son. She just didn't... I wasn't her "type." She said I was a very, colicky baby. You know? Difficult. Not a good sleeper? Didn't eat well? We got off to a bad start, and she never seemed to recoup --

value.name: Marylin confirms maternal disappointment
value.description: Marylin asks whether his mother held the difficult start against him, and Miles answers that she was apparently very disappointed.
evidence: MARYLIN She held that against you?
MILES Apparently she was very disappointed.
